mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) signals stronger economic growth, which compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in a rolling 5-year window despite sustained GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 2.0% signals tightening monetary policy, raising borrowing costs and reducing equity risk premium, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and decline in the CPIAUCSL index (inflation easing) creates a dual signal of monetary tightening and cooling inflation, amplifying positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both FEDFUNDS ↑ and CPIAUCSL ↓ occur, or the signals are not concurrent.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals labor market strength and reduced inflationary pressures, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during late-cycle expansion when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the unemployment rate does not sustain below 4.5% for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals labor market tightness, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during periods of UNRATE decline below 4.0%, or the decline is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A peak in the INDPRO index followed by a decline signals weakening supply-side growth, raising concerns about future economic output and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when INDPRO crosses below its previous high, or the peak was not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals robust demand-side expansion, lowering risk-free rates and enhancing equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 and PAYEMS rise simultaneously, or the increases are not concurrent.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 3.5% signals aggressive policy, increasing borrowing costs and reducing equity risk premium, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS > 3.5% in a tightening cycle, or the rate rise is not sustained.
